label: legitimate
expected_behavior: check_email_authentication verifies SPF, DKIM, DMARC as pass. analyze_links and inspect_attachments find zero threats. Verdict is 'likely safe' with risk score < 20.
actual_result: Verdict: likely safe (Risk: 0.0). Authentication passed with no sender forgery, 1 genuine domain link verified, 0 attachment threats.

label: phishing
expected_behavior: check_email_authentication flags display name spoofing ('helpdesk' on gmail.com), Reply-To domain mismatch, and SPF/DMARC failure. Risk score >= 70, verdict 'phishing'.
actual_result: Verdict: phishing (Risk: 100.0). Flagged SPF/DKIM/DMARC failure, Reply-To mismatch to phishingsite.org, and brand impersonation of helpdesk on free webmail.

label: phishing
expected_behavior: inspect_attachments identifies double extension '.pdf.exe' and executable payload. Tool flags risk >= 90. Verdict is 'phishing'.
actual_result: Verdict: phishing (Risk: 95.0). Flagged dangerous double extension 'Posti_Delivery_Receipt.pdf.exe' and executable binary payload.
